title: THE FINISHER SAYS HOW
why: His words: he did not see a prompt telling him how to do the finisher, but he wants to keep it. The old one was a few small words over a ring, drawn under the REVIVE prompt of the same man, so it was missed. A downed pillager in finisher reach now shows the standard world prompt, the same one the door, the crate and the seal use: HOLD [V] FINISH on a plate, in danger red, with the V drawn as a keycap (the key as you have set it in CHANGE KEYS). It sits where the REVIVE prompt sits and stacks under it when both are up, and the ring under him still fills while you hold. A standing pillager, or you being down, shows nothing. The controller has no melee button, so a pad player is not shown a prompt he could not use. The finisher itself, its 0.55 second hold, its reach and its 100 points are unchanged.
now: A downed pillager in reach shows HOLD V FINISH in the standard world prompt, stacked under the revive prompt.
